    """Return True if the card number passes the Luhn check."""
    digits = number.replace(" ", "")

    if len(digits) < 2 or any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in digits):
        return False

    total = 0
    for index, ch in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
        digit = ord(ch) - ord("0")
        if index % 2 == 1:
            digit *= 2
            if digit > 9:
                digit -= 9
        total += digit

    return total % 10 == 0
